task.description: RESOLVED in the same session as commit 3b42a20. Seven spool records reached the corpus with chosen set to the literal <filled>, because the gate validated the scope signature and the presence of evidence but never looked at whether a hole body carried an expression. Joiner stopped sending placeholders under GB-225, but the receiving side needs the counterpart guard since any producer can hand the corpus an untrainable pair, and a dataset that admits one trains on it. The structural stage now rejects an empty or placeholder hole body and names the hole. Measured: 40 spool records -> 33 accepted, 7 rejected by name (add, human_bytes, smallest_window, grapheme_count); DPO shard went 2 rows -> 0, then to 1 real row after a fresh Gold fill. Gate: clippy -D warnings and 13 tests green.
task.title: The ingest gate accepts a trace whose hole body is a placeholder

receipt.summary: The structural stage now rejects a trace whose filled hole body is empty or the <filled> placeholder, naming the hole, so the corpus cannot accept an untrainable pair from any producer (the HTTP path runs the same gate). Measured on the current spool: 40 records, 33 accepted, 7 rejected by name - add, human_bytes, smallest_window, grapheme_count. Consequence recorded deliberately: the DPO shard dropped from 2 rows to 0 at that point, because both rows were pairs whose chosen side carried no code. After a fresh four-run yield measurement (3 Silver, 1 Gold, all with real bodies) the shards are SFT 16 rows and DPO 1 row with real delegating code. Numbers and the five-defect chain are recorded in .gaugeblock/storypole/plans/JN-9.md.
